subject: website
name: Vitalik Buterin's blog
summary: Vitalik Buterin's blog. Its source is public (the README dedicates the posts to the public under the WTFPL) and it runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. The home page makes no request of its own. It is not Level 4: some posts load images from other hosts (vitalik.ca, Medium's image server, Imgur, Wikimedia and others) when they are read.

connections.name: Images in some posts (vitalik.ca, Medium, Imgur, Wikimedia and others)
connections.note: Fetched when a post that uses them is opened.
